desc:
• LEMON BAR BAKING MIX: Whip up tasty, tangy lemon bars with Betty Crocker Delights Supreme Lemon Bars Mix

  • MADE WITH REAL LEMON: You'll love the tart, sweet tastes of these delicious lemon desserts

  • INCLUDES: Each package includes a pouch of ready-mixed dry crust and filling mix; all you'll need is water and eggs

  • FINISHING TOUCH: For amazing-tasting lemon bars, try sprinkling some powdered sugar on top after the baked goods finish cooling

  • CONTAINS: 16.5 oz (Pack of 12)
features:
Features 

Rich, Fudgy Texture
Delivers moist, chocolatey brownies with a deep, satisfying flavor.

Includes Chocolate Syrup Pouch
Comes with a syrup pouch to enhance the gooeyness and richness of the brownies.

Simple to Make
Just add water, oil, and egg—mix, pour, and bake. No fuss, no mess.

Versatile Baking Options
Suitable for different pan sizes (8x8, 9x9, or 11x7 inches) with included baking time guidance.

Customizable Add-Ins
Easily level up with chocolate chips, nuts, caramel swirls, or your favorite toppings.

Consistent Results
Trusted Betty Crocker quality ensures your brownies come out great every time.

Supports Education
Part of the Box Tops for Education program—each box contributes to school funding.

Family-Friendly Treat
Perfect for baking with kids or sharing during gatherings, parties, or holidays.

Benefits

Quick and Convenient
Have fresh, bakery-style brownies ready in about 30 minutes.

Delicious Every Time
Count on a crowd-pleasing dessert with rich chocolate flavor and perfect chewiness.

Effortless Customization
Easily transform into gourmet-style brownies with simple additions.

Great for Any Occasion
Whether it’s a snack, dessert, or party tray, this mix fits all needs.

Perfect for Beginners and Busy Bakers
Minimal ingredients and steps make it ideal for anyone, regardless of skill level.

Feel-Good Purchase
Enjoy your treat while knowing your purchase helps support local schools.
ingredients: Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Palm Oil, Corn Starch, Canola Oil, Modified Corn Starch, Dried Corn Syrup, Citric Acid, Salt, Lemon Juice Solids, Baking Soda, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Color Added.
